title: Average visible Sun fraction
description: Time-average of the visible solar disk fraction above the local LOLA horizon.
method: LOLA LDEM_64 horizons ray-marched on the 1737.4 km sphere (72 azimuths, observer 2 m, 0.5-300 km), computed on demand in the Sun's azimuth and only as far as terrain could still hide the lower solar limb; SPICE DE440 Sun in MOON_ME, LT+S, real angular radius; visible disk fraction per sample.
